title: Toronto ARMY Rallies Ahead of BTS's First Canadian Shows Since 2018
detail: August 20, 2026 — With BTS's two-night Rogers Stadium stand two days out (Aug 22-23) — the group's first Canadian concerts since 2018 — local fan community BTS Army Toronto, run by Sokvin Vann and her son Jordan, describes a citywide buildup ARMY are calling a homecoming. 'It feels like a homecoming, right? From 2018 to the missed 2020 concert. Now eight years later, it feels like our seven kings are coming home,' Vann told reporters. Rogers Stadium is expected to draw roughly 100,000 fans across the two sold-out nights.

media.caption: BTS Army Toronto anticipates the group's first Canadian shows since 2018 at Rogers Stadium.
